title.en: GPS Spoofing of Vessel ECDIS Positioning

damage_scale.en: Induced course deviation for multiple vessels

desc.en: GPS signals were manipulated for multiple vessels in the Black Sea, causing incorrect position displays and creating a risk of course deviation and collision.
